description: Create comprehensive logging system that captures all agent decisions, tool calls, retries, failures, and outputs in structured JSON format. Logs should prove autonomous operation, show decision-making process, track error recovery attempts, and provide audit trail. Extend existing .bowman/memory/sessions/ structure to generate agent_log.json format.

status.comment: Felix 2026-10-16: cancel. Git history plus supervisor-errors.log already cover the audit need; a separate agent_log.json would add privacy, size and retention costs.
